scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('curl -fL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o yt-dlp && chmod +x yt-dlp', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) { console.error('Gagal unduh yt-dlp:', e.message); process.exit(1); }"
